story.title: Georgia does not feel far away here.
story.lead: IMERULI grew out of a longing for a table where there is always room for one more guest.
story.columnOne: We cook so everything can be shared: khachapuri straight from the oven, khinkali folded on site and dishes fragrant with coriander, tarragon and freshly ground pepper.
story.columnTwo: The name leads back to Imereti — the green region of western Georgia, where hospitality is part of everyday life and a meal never ends with just one plate.
story.quote: A guest is a gift. The table is a meeting place.
story.imageAlt: A laid table in the warm interior of IMERULI restaurant
story.mapAria: Open the IMERULI location in Google Maps

legal.draftText: Restaurant details are demonstrational. Before publication, this document must be completed with the owner, hosting and actual integration details and then verified.
legal.lead: The text below describes the actual behaviour of the current website version and does not declare services that have not yet been connected.

sections.title: 1. Data controller
sections.content: The data controller will be the entity operating the IMERULI restaurant. Before publication, the full legal name, registered address, tax identification number and correct controller contact address must be added.

sections.title: 2. Contact form
sections.content: If you provide an email address, it will be used only to respond to your contact request. The production version must identify the legal basis, retention period, mailbox provider and data recipients. The current form is demonstrational and sends no data to a server.

sections.title: 3. Technical data
sections.content: The hosting server may record standard technical logs, including the IP address, request time, resource address and browser information. Before publication, the hosting provider, purpose, legal basis and log retention period must be specified.

sections.title: 4. Recipients and transfers
sections.content: This version does not embed Google Maps, Google Reviews or analytics tools. Clicking an external Google link takes you away from the IMERULI website and is then governed by Google’s privacy rules. Any future integration must be described before launch.

sections.title: 5. Your rights
sections.content: Depending on the basis for processing, you may have the right to access, rectify or erase data, restrict processing, object, transfer data and withdraw consent. You may also lodge a complaint with the competent data protection authority.

sections.title: 6. Contact
sections.content: Privacy contact address before publication: [add the controller’s correct email address].

sections.title: 1. Current status
sections.content: The current website version does not store analytics or marketing cookies and does not use advertising identifiers. It also does not embed an interactive map or Google reviews.

sections.title: 2. Menu and settings
sections.content: The selected language is saved in the browser’s localStorage so the preference can be retained for a future visit. The active menu page remains only in application state during the current visit.

sections.title: 3. External links
sections.content: The map, directions and review profile open Google only after a deliberate click. From that point, browser settings and the external service’s policies apply.

sections.title: 4. Future integrations
sections.content: If the owner enables analytics, an embedded map, a review widget or marketing, those services must remain blocked until the user makes the appropriate choice. Refusal must not block the menu, contact details or navigation.
